title: 第六章 忍者学校第七章 夕日红
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
"什么事啊？"冥帝不由得向着玖辛奈问道。
"冥帝啊，你是喜欢弟弟呢？还是妹妹？"玖辛奈笑着道。
"弟弟。"冥帝道。他早就知道玖辛奈要是再怀孕，生的肯定就是鸣人了。
"好，那妈妈以后每天晚上一定努力！争取为冥帝弄出一个弟弟出来。"玖辛奈撅着嘴道。闻言，冥帝狂汗。。。。。。
第二天，冥帝便是开始去忍者学校了，波风水门早把忍者学校的入学通知书拿回了家中！玖辛奈等的就是这一刻！
这一天，玖辛奈打扮的很漂亮，才是带着冥帝朝着忍者学校而去。忍者学校的大门终于已近在眼前，门口一个个孩子正由自己的父母领着准备去报到，而佐助也非常幸运地看到了几个熟面孔。
西瓜头的铁血凯，还有犬冢花，神月出云，御手洗红豆，伊鲁卡，卯月夕颜。
"一年级一班的到我这里来报名了"拿着一张报名册的森乃伊比喜开始吼道。
"冥帝，快点去报道吧，我先回去了，就不陪你了，要加油！"玖辛奈对冥帝说道，然后就向回家的路走去了。
玖辛奈知道，冥帝这孩子虽然小，但已经长大了，**独行，完全没问题。
平静了一下心态，冥帝迈着稳健的步伐对着伊比喜走去，叫了入学通知书后就和铁血凯等人一起跟着伊比喜走向教室里。到了之后，伊比喜就编排了位置。
等清点了一下人数后，伊比喜微笑着说道："好了现在人都到齐了，请大家做一下自我介绍，互相认识一下。我先自我介绍吧，我叫森乃伊比喜，目前是中忍，以后就是你们的班主任了，请多多指教，那么，就由迈特凯先来吧。"
"我叫迈特凯。青春，就是要勇于报上姓名"说完铁血凯便是一脸兴奋的手舞足蹈了起来。
他是复读生！卡卡西毕业了，他还在学校。
"好傻啊！""好蠢啊"不用说铁血凯从小就是被一堆女人嫌弃大的！
"我叫犬冢花，喜欢狗尾巴花。"犬冢花忙不迭地说道。
"我叫卯月夕颜??????""我叫水木?????""我???我叫???伊鲁???卡?????""我叫神月出云啊"
"我叫波风冥帝"冥帝站起来说道。名字一出，不单单是其他学生，就是伊比喜也是深深的看了冥帝一样，随后点了点头。
这便是波风水门家的妖孽吗？
"我叫路人甲??????""我叫路人乙??????"??????

"好了，既然大家都认识了，那么大家现在先相互熟悉一下，以后就要做同学了。我去把书领过来，你们就先等一会吧！"伊比喜道。
"好的。"众人异口同声地回答道。看起来大家都很乖巧。
但是等到伊比喜离开教室后，情况发生了急剧性逆转，所有人都变得不安分了，教室开始向菜市场转化。
这之中也就只有三个人一直保持着安静，一个就是卯月夕颜，很安静的女生，一个就是御手洗红豆，她一脸忧伤的样子，似乎有什么沉重的记忆，以及睡觉哥冥帝了。
冥帝知道自己必须最大程度降低长老团的戒心，但要学鸣人？那怎么看怎么白痴，因此，冥帝左想右想之下，终于决定一个有天才有安全的处事方法--睡觉，对，就是睡觉。
content_en:
"What's going on?" Emperor Hades couldn't help but ask Kushina.
"Underworld Emperor, do you like your younger brother? Or your younger sister?" Kushina said with a smile.
"Brother." Emperor Hades said. He had long known that if Kushina got pregnant again, the child would definitely be Naruto.
"Okay, then mom will work hard every night from now on! Try to find a younger brother for Emperor Hades." Kushina pouted. Hearing this, Emperor Hades sweated violently. . . . . .
The next day, Hades began to go to the ninja school. Namikaze Minato had already taken the admission notice of the ninja school back home! Kushina has been waiting for this moment!
On this day, Kushina dressed up beautifully and led Hades towards the ninja school. The gate of the ninja school was finally in sight. Children at the door were being led by their parents to report, and Sasuke was very lucky to see a few familiar faces.
The watermelon-headed Tetsukai Kai, as well as Inuzuka Hana, Kamizuki Izumo, Mitarashi Anko, Iruka, and Uzuki Yuugao.
"Everyone from Class 1, Grade 1 came to my place to register," Morino Ihiki started yelling while holding a registration form.
"Emperor Hades, hurry up and report. I'm going back first, so I won't accompany you. Come on!" Kushina said to Emperor Hades, and then walked home.
Kushina knew that although the child of Emperor Hades was young, he had grown up and walked alone, which was completely fine.
After calming down his mind, Hades walked towards Ibixi with steady steps. After calling out the admission notice, he followed Ibixi to the classroom with Tie Xue Kai and others. After arriving, Ibixi arranged the location.
After counting the number of people, Ibiki said with a smile: "Okay, now that everyone is here, please introduce yourself and get to know each other. Let me introduce myself first. My name is Morino Ibiki. I am currently a chuunin and will be your homeroom teacher in the future. Please give me your advice. Then, let Metkai come first."
"My name is Metkai. Youth means having the courage to state your name." After saying this, Iron-Blooded Kai started dancing with excitement.
He is a repeat student! Kakashi graduated, he was still in school.
"It's so stupid!" "It's so stupid." Needless to say, Iron-Blooded Kai has been disliked by a lot of women since he was a child!
"My name is Inuzuka Hana, and I like dog tail flowers." Inuzuka Hana said hurriedly.
"My name is Uzuki Xiyan??????" "My name is Mizuki???" "My name is??? Iru???ka??????" "My name is Kamizuki Izumo."
"My name is Namikaze Hades," Hades stood up and said. As soon as the name came out, not only the other students, but also Ibixi looked deeply like Hades, and then nodded.
Is this the monster from the Minato Namikaze family?
"My name is Passerby A??????""My name is Passerby B??????"??????
"Okay, now that we all know each other, let's get to know each other first, and then we will become classmates. I will go and get the books, you just wait for a while!" Ibixi said.
"Okay." Everyone replied in unison. Everyone seems to be well behaved.
But after Ibixi left the classroom, the situation took a drastic turn. Everyone became restless, and the classroom started toBegins to transform into a vegetable market.
There are only three people among them who have remained quiet, one is Uzuki Yugan, a very quiet girl, the other is Anko Mitarashi, who has a sad look on her face, as if she has some heavy memories, and the sleeping brother Hades.
Emperor Hades knew that he had to lower the vigilance of the elders as much as possible, but wanted to imitate Naruto? That looks like an idiot, so after thinking about it, Emperor Hades finally decided on a genius and safe way to deal with things - sleep, yes, sleep.
